page.layout: One printed page, one table in two blocks separated by a rule. Top: running head "ANNORVM." with page number 469 at the top right, and a column-label line. Below: a table of 29 rows with columns Indict., An. Iul., Lit. dom., Nabon., Feriae, Christi., with day labels (Febr.) beside the Feriae column. Foot: signature "Gg üj" at the bottom centre.

main_text.l: Indict. | An. Iul. | Lit. dom. | Nabon. | Feriae | Christi.

page.notes: The Christi. column is set at the right edge with the year numbers 777 to 806. The first Indict. row is 15 at the top left, and the rows of the second block restart at 1. The signature "Gg üj" is partly unclear. The day labels Febr. stand beside the Feriae column, and the day figures are printed in Roman-style numerals as shown. The "Indict." and "An. Iul." header words are as printed.
